A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' was at one point present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Buoyant]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the planet, causing it to rotate faster. The species also used a number of machines on Buoyant and imported various animal species to the world.
